name: gizza-ai/csv-insert-column
summary: Insert a constant column into a CSV.

tool.description: Insert a new column into a CSV at a chosen 1-based position (or 'end' to append), filling every data row with a constant `value`. The header row gets the column `name`. Useful for adding an id/source/constant flag column. `position` is clamped to the row width.

name.description: Header name for the new column (used when header=true).

value.description: Constant value to fill the new column in every data row. Default empty.

position.description: 1-based position to insert at, or 'end' to append (default). Clamped to the row width.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (gets `name`; data rows get `value`). Default true.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
